description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2 +1 ne nje objekt te ri ne nderim, i pozicionuar ne zonen ekerkuar te Ish Fushes se Aviacionit, nje nga zonat me zhvillim te shpejt urban ne Tirane. Objekti ndodhet prane pedonales dhe ka akses ne rruget kryesore te qytetit. Ndertim cilesor me standarte bashkekohore.
Zone e qete, me infrastrukture ne zgjerim te vazhdueshem. Investim i sigurt dhe me potencial te larte rritjeje ne vlere.
description_en: 2 +1 apartment for sale in a new building in respect, positioned in the sought-after area of ​​the Former Aviation Field, one of the areas with fast urban development in Tirana. The object is located near the pedestrian area and has access to the main streets of the city. Quality construction with contemporary standards. Quiet area, with infrastructure in continuous expansion. Safe investment with high growth potential.
